t: From Kansas to Oz: Engineering Emotion with CSS and AI
s: This article details the shift from a demo system's foundational 'brains' (robustness, persistence) to its 'heart' (emotional user experience). It uses the Wizard of Oz narrative as a blueprint for implementing a cinematic black-and-white to color transition on the homepage using CSS filters and AI assistance for code.
sub: Cinematic UI transition (B&W to color) using CSS filters and JavaScript.
Allegory of "The Wizard of Oz" for software development phases (brains, heart, courage).
CSS `filter: grayscale()` and `transition` for animated visual effects.
